rows.name: Dawnguard Hunter

target.source: user, 2026-11-13: accepted; the Dawnguard's band (bands-of-power.md); it borrows the bandit boss ladder, which the rebuild pins to 28 (V)

rows.note: borrows its level from the bandit chiefs: it takes only `Stats` from `LCharBanditBossNordM` 01A341, so it rolls the bandit boss ladder 6 · 10 · 16 · 21 · 28 (gates 1 · 5 · 9 · 14 · 19 · 25 · 29). Changing that ladder changes it. Moved here from Uncategorised → *Bandit Level Borrowers* (user, 2026-10-03).

items: Every row: no other record keeps its own level.

The six rungs take `EncDawnguard00Template` (which follows `DLC1EncHunterTemplate` 00336F:Dawnguard.esm) as their template but not for `Stats`, so changing that template (on *Dawnguard Members*) does not move them.

The Dawnguard Hunter carries `Stats` and follows the bandit boss ladder; the records that keep their own level beside that ladder (the CC Bounty Hunter, Kyr, Fjola, the `WEDL05` Thug) are listed on Bandits → *Bandit Chiefs*.

Every other Dawnguard record (the seven race variants of each rung, every `DLC1LvlDawnguard…` wrapper and its `_NoCrime` copy, the `DLC1WEDB03DLVLDawnGuard…` three) carries `Stats` and follows its template or list.
